title: IRIS model reconstructs signaling histories of single cells
summary: IRIS inferred signaling histories from gene activity after training on human stem-cell perturbations. The researchers used it to identify a signaling intervention predicted to encourage lung development and report experimental confirmation in mouse embryos. This summary is limited to MIT/Whitehead’s October 15, 2026 announcement, which explicitly dates the Nature Methods paper to September 8. The release supplies no quantitative accuracy metrics; proposed organoid and therapeutic uses are future applications.
organization: MIT; Whitehead Institute for Biomedical Research

evidence.tested: Inferred cell signaling histories and a lung-development prediction checked in mouse embryos, according to the institutional release.
evidence.unknown: Source checking does not establish independent confirmation. Review date: 2026-11-15.
evidence.ai_role: IRIS learns consistent pathway fingerprints in gene activity across cell types, reconstructs signaling histories, and generated the lung-development prediction that was tested in mouse embryos.
